code_review.project_type: static website — marketing & documentation site (HTML/CSS multi-page site)

architecture.summary: A directory-per-route static site: each page is a folder containing its own index.html (e.g. /about/, /docs/rounds/, /agents/phaser/), sharing a single styles.css and a small set of image/icon assets. A parallel rework/ directory holds Markdown drafts that appear to mirror several of the published HTML pages, suggesting an authoring/staging workflow that precedes hand-conversion to HTML.
architecture.inferred_from: file tree layout: about/index.html, docs/*/index.html, agents/*/index.html

languages.name: HTML
languages.source: index.html and per-page index.html files throughout the tree

directory_map.role: Per-agent marketing/landing pages, one per Spec4 pipeline agent (agentifier, brainstormer, codescanner, deployer, designer, phaser, reviewer, stackadvisor)
Product documentation pages (index, agentifier, artifacts, brainstormer, codescanner, deployer, designer, phaser, rounds, settings) plus a settings screenshot asset
Standalone page of unclear purpose (possibly a sub-brand/feature)
Markdown drafts mirroring several docs/* and other pages, plus a scratch 'temp' file

ui_summary.styling: Shared custom stylesheet (styles.css) applied across all pages
ui_summary.routing: Folder-per-page structure yields clean URLs (e.g. /about/, /docs/rounds/, /agents/phaser/); no client-side router

incomplete_or_dead_code: rework/temp is an extensionless file of unclear purpose alongside the Markdown drafts, likely a scratch/staging artifact rather than shipped content; Phaser should avoid building on it.

rework/*.md files (e.g. rework/docs-phaser.md) closely mirror published docs/*/index.html and agents/*/index.html pages but have no build step tying them together, creating content-drift risk between drafts and live HTML.
other_notes: robots.txt and sitemap.xml present, indicating the site is configured for search-engine indexing.
bws4/index.html (with corresponding rework/bws4.md draft) is a distinct sub-page whose purpose is unclear from the file tree alone.
examples/deployment-plan.html/.md and examples/mock.html appear to be static example/demo artifacts displayed on the marketing site, not live application output.
